Summary: <EVENT_SUMMARY>
USER_CONTEXT: Generate a PoC for Use-of-uninitialized-value vulnerability in OVS ODP action parsing (nl_attr_get_size → parse_odp_action → odp_actions_from_string)

COMPLETED:
- Analyzed SCAN macros (SCAN_BEGIN, SCAN_SINGLE, SCAN_END, SCAN_PUT, etc.) in odp-util.c lines 5042-5240
- Verified OFPBUF_STUB_INITIALIZER sets .size=0 for stack buffer
- Confirmed parse_odp_key_mask_attr always adds attributes to both key and mask buffers on success
- Identified UFID skip at line 5368 returns early without adding to buffers (but would fail subsequent ')' check)
- Examined encap() handler (lines 5505-5545) which recursively calls parse_odp_key_mask_attr
- Verified nl_msg_end_nested properly updates nla_len (line 498-508 in netlink.c)

PENDING:
- Determine exact input string that triggers uninitialized read in set() handler's mask buffer
- Create PoC input file
- Submit using `bash ./submit.sh PATH_TO_POC /workspace/candidate_trace.json`

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: /workspace
- Vulnerable code: parse_odp_action set() handler (lines 2200-2235 in odp-util.c)
- Stack buffer: struct nlattr mask[1024/sizeof(struct nlattr)] initialized via OFPBUF_STUB_INITIALIZER
- Key insight: mask buffer starts with .size=0; if parse_odp_key_mask_attr succeeds but maskbuf remains empty, nl_attr_get_size(mask) reads uninitialized stack data
- All SCAN macros appear to add to mask buffer when mask parameter is non-NULL

CODE_STATE:
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openvswitch/lib/odp-util.c
- Functions analyzed: parse_odp_key_mask_attr (line 5363), parse_odp_action set() handler (line 2200+)
- Macros: SCAN_BEGIN (5062), SCAN_SINGLE (5214), SCAN_END_SINGLE (5208), SCAN_PUT (5153), SCAN_IF (5054), OFPBUF_STUB_INITIALIZER (ofpbuf.h:78)
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openvswitch/lib/netlink.c
- Functions: nl_msg_start_nested (486), nl_msg_end_nested (498), nl_attr_get_size (596)

TESTS: N/A

CHANGES: N/A

DEPS: N/A

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: N/A
</EVENT_SUMMARY>
